definitions.explanation: The pressure of blood against the walls of the arteries.

examples.japanese: {血圧|けつあつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}って→測る：01977_hakaru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。

notes:
{血圧|けつあつ} is an important medical term.

Types of blood pressure:
- ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{血圧|けつあつ} / ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧{血圧|けつあつ} (systolic blood pressure)
- ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{血圧|けつあつ} / ⟦{最低|さいてい}→最低：01412_saitei⟧{血圧|けつあつ} (diastolic blood pressure)

Conditions:
- ⟦{高|こう}{血圧|けつあつ}→高血圧：04415_kouketsuatsu⟧ (high blood pressure, hypertension)
- ⟦{低|てい}{血圧|けつあつ}→低血圧：07103_teiketsuatsu⟧ (low blood pressure, hypotension)
